thread:
Maya: Deploy-bot flagged canary for release 2026.03.20 in us-west-2 — canary failing healthchecks, rolling back on hold. can someone triage?

deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary failure detected for release '2026.03.20' (canary id: c-493). 3/5 pods failing healthcheck in prod-usw2. Symptoms: 503 on /health, KMS decrypt errors in app logs. See: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/493

Aj: On it. can you paste the deploy manifest or helm diff?

Chen: quick logs from one of the failing pods:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:13Z ERROR decrypt.go:48 failed to unwrap key: kms:DecodeKeyResponse: alias 'redwood/svc-modeler' not found
2026-03-20T14:02:14Z WARN health.go:73 dependency-check failed: 503 upstream model-server
2026-03-20T14:02:15Z INFO env.go:29 SECRET_PATH=/etc/creds/modeler.json
```

Maya: staging's helm overlay had `secretMountPath: /etc/creds/modeler.json`, but the release branch accidentally included a local dev override setting `secretMountPath: /etc/service/creds`. looks like canary used the branch overlay while prod controller expects the canonical path. also noticed image tag mismatch: canary image tag `2026.03.20` vs prod pinned `2026.03.18` (digest differs).

Aj: ah that's nasty — so two parity problems: secret mount path and image/tag pinning. Which one is causing the KMS alias error?

Chen: KMS alias error looks unrelated to mount path directly — it suggests the KMS alias `redwood/svc-modeler` doesn't exist in the account used by the canary nodes. I suspect the canary was routed to a cluster account with a stale KMS aliases list (cloud account mismatch). the missing secret path would cause config failures, but here both appear.

sre-lead: summary: (1) canary ran new image and new helm overlay -> pods got routed to nodes in prod-usw2 that don't have the KMS alias configured, so decrypt fails. (2) staging vs prod helm values differ for secretMountPath, increasing chance of config drift.

Maya: immediate mitigation options: rollback canary/promotion, pin release manifest to prod image digest, or patch KMS aliases (but that requires infra change and takes longer). Recommend pin to prod digest and abort promotion until we fix overlays. Thoughts? :warning:

Aj: I vote pin and abort. patching infra in the middle of a release is higher blast radius.

Chen: agree. we can pin the image in the release manifest to the existing prod digest and re-run the canary. also open a post-release follow-up to audit helm overlays and the account/alias mapping.

Maya: OK I'll run the pin. command: `kubectl -n prod-usw2 set image deployment/modeler modeler=redwood/modeler@sha256:0f1e2d3c4b5a6d7e8f9a -o yaml` then re-trigger canary.

ops-bot: @maya requested an image pin for canary c-493. Creating release rollback action and tagging oncall.

deploy-bot: Promotion aborted for release '2026.03.20' (reason: canary healthcheck failed). Action: pin image to sha256:0f1e2d... and re-run canary after confirmation.

sre-lead: I've added a temporary hold to the release and created ISSUE-4527 to standardize `secretMountPath` across overlays + validate KMS alias presence as part of pre-promote checks.

Maya: PR #6123 opened to normalize helm values and add preflight check for KMS aliases. pin applied, re-triggering canary now. will monitor logs and post updates.

Chen: canary pods are coming up. initial logs show KMS alias resolved, no decrypt errors yet. healthchecks passing on 2/5, giving it a few mins.

Aj: thanks everyone. we'll keep the hold until canary is stable in both mount path and KMS checks. follow-up: run a one-off job to enumerate KMS aliases across us-west-2 and prod-usw2 cluster accounts (assign to infra).

Maya: noted. closing in #release-notes and adding a short blurb for the incident: "Canary halted due to env-parity: KMS alias missing + helm overlay mount path mismatch; release pinned to prod image digest and hold placed. Follow-up: ISSUE-4527 (helm overlays, KMS preflight)." :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Hold placed on release '2026.03.20' by @maya. Link: https://releases.redwood.internal/releases/2026.03.20

deploy-bot: Canary c-493 re-run complete: 5/5 healthy. Release hold continues pending postmortem/PR merge.

Maya: great, leaving hold for now. thanks all.
